name: Hassiacosuchus
isnote: An alligatorid (Cossette & Brochu 2020); its position inside Alligatoridae varies, and it has been argued to be a synonym of Allognathosuchus (Wassersug & Hecht 1967).
sum: Small alligatorid from the early Eocene Messel Pit, Germany.
wsnote: Small; the sources give no measurements.
holotype: Type material of H. haupti from the Messel Pit (Weitzel 1935).
material: Specimens from Messel; a second species, H. kayi, was moved to Procaimanoidea.
biology: A small alligatorid of the Messel lake; the sources say little more.
author: Weitzel 1935

sources.text: Weitzel, K. 1935. ''Hassiacosuchus haupti'' n. g. n. sp., ein durophages Krokodil aus dem Mitteleozän von Messel. Notizblatt des Vereins für Erdkunde und der Hessischen Geologischen Landesanstalt Darmstadt 16: 40–49.

Adam P. Cossette 2020. A systematic review of the giant alligatoroid ''Deinosuchus'' from the Campanian of North America and its implications for the relationships at the root of Crocodylia. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 40(1). doi:10.1080/02724634.2020.1767638
